name: limova-ai-extension
description: Limova AI — Charly, onboarding assistant Chrome extension (MV3)

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:staging && playwright test
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:session:staging: npm run build:staging && LIMOVA_E2E_ENV=staging EXTENSION_PATH=build-staging playwright test tests/e2e/limova-cookie-session.spec.js
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:package
scripts.release:package: npm run test:all && npm run build
